Elements.Script:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

getgenv().PRFB_SelectedRarity = {[ 'All' ] = true}
getgenv().PRFB_SelectedBrainrots = {[ 'All' ] = true}
getgenv().PRFB_AutoTake = false

local function getNormalFolder()
    local gui = lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
    local menus = gui and gui:FindFirstChild('Menus')
    local index = menus and menus:FindFirstChild('Index')
    local mainFrame = index and index:FindFirstChild('MainFrame')
    local mainBar = mainFrame and mainFrame:FindFirstChild('MainBar')
    return mainBar and mainBar:FindFirstChild('Normal')
end

local function trim(s)
    s = tostring(s or '')
    return (s:gsub('^%\s*(.-)%\s*$', '%1'))
end

local function normalizeSelection(v)
    local selected = {}
    if type(v) == 'string' then
        selected[v] = true
    elseif type(v) == 'table' then
        if #v > 0 then
            for _, name in ipairs(v) do
                if type(name) == 'string' then
                    selected[name] = true
                end
            end
        else
            for name, enabled in pairs(v) do
                if enabled then
                    selected[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local hasNonAll = false
    for name, enabled in pairs(selected) do
        if enabled and name ~= 'All' then
            hasNonAll = true
            break
        end
    end

    if hasNonAll then
        selected['All'] = nil
    end

    if next(selected) == nil then
        selected['All'] = true
    end

    return selected
end

local function isAllSelected(selected)
    selected = selected or {}
    for name, enabled in pairs(selected) do
        if enabled and name ~= 'All' then
            return false
        end
    end
    return selected['All'] == true or next(selected) == nil
end

local function getButtonRarity(button)
    local rarity = button:FindFirstChild('IndexRarity')
    if rarity and (rarity:IsA('TextLabel') or rarity:IsA('TextBox')) then
        return trim(rarity.Text)
    end
    return ''
end

local function buildIndexMap()
    local map = {}
    local normal = getNormalFolder()
    if not normal then
        return map
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(normal:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA('ImageButton') then
            local name = trim(child.Name)
            if name ~= '' then
                map[name] = {
                    rarity = getButtonRarity(child)
                }
            end
        end
    end

    return map
end

local function raritySelected(rarity)
    local selected = getgenv().PRFB_SelectedRarity or {[ 'All' ] = true}
    if isAllSelected(selected) then
        return true
    end

    rarity = string.lower(trim(rarity))
    if rarity == '' then
        return false
    end

    for name, enabled in pairs(selected) do
        if enabled and name ~= 'All' and string.lower(trim(name)) == rarity then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function getRarityValues()
    local values = {'All'}
    local seen = {['All'] = true}
    local normal = getNormalFolder()
    if not normal then
        return values
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(normal:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA('ImageButton') then
            local rarity = getButtonRarity(child)
            if rarity ~= '' and not seen[rarity] then
                seen[rarity] = true
                table.insert(values, rarity)
            end
        end
    end

    return values
end

local function getBrainrotValues(selectedRarity)
    local values = {'All'}
    local seen = {['All'] = true}
    local normal = getNormalFolder()
    if not normal then
        return values
    end

    local selected = selectedRarity or {[ 'All' ] = true}

    for _, child in ipairs(normal:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA('ImageButton') then
            local rarity = getButtonRarity(child)
            if isAllSelected(selected) or raritySelected(rarity) then
                local name = trim(child.Name)
                if name ~= '' and not seen[name] then
                    seen[name] = true
                    table.insert(values, name)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return values
end

local function brainrotMatches(name)
    local selected = getgenv().PRFB_SelectedBrainrots or {[ 'All' ] = true}
    if isAllSelected(selected) then
        return true
    end

    local n = string.lower(trim(name))

    for sel, enabled in pairs(selected) do
        if enabled and sel ~= 'All' then
            local s = string.lower(trim(sel))
            if s == n then
                return true
            end
            if n:find(s, 1, true) then
                return true
            end
            if s:find(n, 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local brainrotDropdown
local prfb_updatingBrainrots = false

brainrotDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('PRFB_Brainrots', {
    Title = 'Select Brainrots',
    Values = getBrainrotValues({['All'] = true}),
    Default = {'All'},
    Multi = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        if prfb_updatingBrainrots then
            return
        end
        getgenv().PRFB_SelectedBrainrots = normalizeSelection(v)
    end
})

local function getRoot()
    local char = lp.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
end

local function getFinishPart()
    local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild('Zones')
    return zones and zones:FindFirstChild('FinishPart')
end

local function touchFinishIfCarrying()
    if lp:GetAttribute('isCarrying') ~= true then
        return false
    end

    local root = getRoot()
    local finish = getFinishPart()
    if root and finish and finish:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest') then
        firetouchinterest(root, finish, 0)
        task.wait()
        firetouchinterest(root, finish, 1)
    end

    return true
end

local function findTargetInZones()
    local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild('Zones')
    if not zones then
        return nil
    end

    local indexMap = buildIndexMap()

    for _, zone in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
        if zone.Name:match('^Zone') then
            for _, candidate in ipairs(zone:GetChildren()) do
                if candidate:IsA('Model') then
                    local stand = candidate:FindFirstChild('StandPrimary')
                    local prompt = stand and stand:FindFirstChild('CollectPrompt')
                    if stand and prompt and prompt:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then
                        if not stand:FindFirstChild('CarryWeld') then
                            local info = indexMap[trim(candidate.Name)]
                            local rarityOk = info and raritySelected(info.rarity)
                            if rarityOk and brainrotMatches(candidate.Name) then
                                return candidate
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function teleportToTarget(target)
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root or not target then
        return
    end

    local stand = target:FindFirstChild('StandPrimary')
    if not stand then
        return
    end

    root.CFrame = stand.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

    local prompt = stand:FindFirstChild('CollectPrompt')
    if prompt and prompt:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then
        fireproximityprompt(prompt)
    end
end

Value:AddToggle('PRFB_AutoTake', {
    Title = 'Auto Take',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        getgenv().PRFB_AutoTake = v
        if v then
            task.spawn(function()
                while getgenv().PRFB_AutoTake do
                    pcall(function()
                        if touchFinishIfCarrying() then
                            return
                        end

                        local target = findTargetInZones()
                        if target and target.Parent then
                            while getgenv().PRFB_AutoTake and target.Parent do
                                if touchFinishIfCarrying() then
                                    break
                                end

                                local stand = target:FindFirstChild('StandPrimary')
                                if not stand or stand:FindFirstChild('CarryWeld') then
                                    break
                                end

                                teleportToTarget(target)
                                task.wait(0.1)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})
